verses.1: If a man takes a woman as his wife, and if she does not please him in any way, then he will find fault with her. He will write a scolding letter to her, give it to her, and send her away from his house.
verses.2: And she left her house, went away, and became another woman’s wife.
verses.3: And the other man desired her. He wrote her a marriage contract, gave it to her, and sent her away from his house. This happened because the other man had died, and she became his wife.
verses.4: The first husband could not take her back as his wife, after she became pregnant. It was because it was an act of disobedience before the LORD. Do not destroy the land that the LORD your God has given you as a inheritance.
verses.5: For when a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out in public without her. He shall also not do anything that would bring disgrace upon his house. He shall live with his wife for one year, and then he shall rejoice in having taken her as his wife.
verses.6: He will not let out his breath or move his limbs, for his soul is the one that moves them.
verses.7: For if a thief is found among the children of Israel, and he becomes his own master and sells himself to him, then that thief will die. And in that evil city, far from you, he will be destroyed.
verses.8: Keep the laws and regulations carefully, and carry out everything that the holy priests have commanded you to do.
verses.9: Remember what Jehovah your God did to Mary, when you left Egypt.
verses.10: For if you bring any gifts to him, do not go into his house to carry out those gifts.
verses.11: Stand outside, and the man in whom you are married will bring you out of this difficult situation.
verses.12: And if a person is poor, he shall not sleep in the dust.
verses.13: May he be restored to his rightful place, just as the sun rises and sets in its due position. May he rest in peace and happiness. And may justice be upon you before Jehovah your God.
verses.14: Do not oppress a poor servant or an old man who is among your own people, or those who live in your land.
verses.15: At that time, he will give him his reward. But the sun will not shine upon him, because he is poor. He will bring his soul to Him, and he will not call upon Jehovah. Thus, there will be a sin in you.
verses.16: Fathers shall not die on their children’s behalf, and children shall not die on their fathers’ behalf. No man shall die in his sin.
verses.17: Do not commit evil deeds, and do not wear clothes that are not proper to be worn by a man.
verses.18: And you remember that you were a slave in Egypt. But Jehovah your God freed you from there. Therefore, I command you to do what is commanded here.
verses.19: For if you cut down your grain in the field, and forget to plant it again in the same field, then you will not be able to harvest it for sowing. But if you plant it again, it will be useful for blessing you, O LORD your God, in all your works.
verses.20: For if you conceal your sins, you will not be able to please God. Your actions will only bring disgrace and shame.
verses.21: For if you destroy your vineyard, do not go and plant it again for others. It will become a waste of time and effort.
verses.22: And you remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt. Therefore, I command you to do this.
